arguments.text: The statement explicitly asserts that Melissa's offer was made as an agent of Mark.

arguments.text: The statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted, specifically to establish whether Melissa was acting as Mark's agent.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(3) - offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of whether Melissa was the agent of Mark

arguments.text: There is no indication the statement is offered for a non-hearsay purpose such as notice, effect on listener, or as a verbal act.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) hearsay definition excludes non-assertive or non-truth-purpose uses.

arguments.text: The potential exclusion for party-opponent admissions under FRE 801(d)(2)(D) is relevant but hinges on independent proof of agency, which is disputed.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(d)(2)(D) - statement by party's agent on matter within scope.
